name: Morro Bay
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Morro Bay?
answer_short: Yes, with the California caps. In Morro Bay, a golf cart may use a street posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district. An LSV may use a road posted 35 mph or less. US 101 is a freeway and is closed to both.

rules.rule: Golf carts on highways posted 25 mph or less in a business or residence district
LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; they may cross faster roads at intersections
Freeway; no golf carts or LSVs

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Morro Bay?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Registered and insured. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart on a 25 mph street in Morro Bay?
faq.a: Yes, in a business or residence district, under CVC 21716.

faq.q: Can an LSV use a 35 mph road?
faq.a: Yes. California limits LSVs to roads posted 35 mph or less.
